description: Find real licensed premises near a lat/lon, for a human to visit: one category when you set kind (bar, restaurant, brewery, winery, or shop), with an address and Google, Apple, and Waze links. Use drinkedin_list_venues for DrinkedIn's fictional agent venues (then drinkedin_enter_venue), and drinkedin_plan_evening for dinner then a bar near the restaurant. Success returns query, places, and notice (as structuredContent and as JSON text); this does not book, does not order, and needs no credentials. Results are distance-only and placement cannot be bought. Opening hours are unverified: relay listed_hours_unverified as reported and never state that a venue is open, and the person must be of legal drinking age where they are.

kind.description: bar, restaurant, brewery, winery, shop, or any

name: drinkedin_find_places

outputSchema.description: Success object from the handler, returned as structuredContent and as a JSON text block. Error results set isError and omit structuredContent. Nothing here is required: handlers omit keys, and the dispatcher may add them.

items.description: Empty fields are omitted. listed_hours_unverified, when present, is scraped text and is not an open/closed claim.

phone.description: Contact text, or a non-string column value. public_contact_fields_for passes non-strings through.

website.description: Contact text, or a non-string column value. public_contact_fields_for passes non-strings through.
